risks.title: Downturn in Global Economy
risks.score_rationale: Risk is placed first among risk factors with strong language regarding substantial adverse effect. Directly impacts vehicle demand, the core of Dana's business. Dependency on economic conditions is repeated multiple times, compounded by exposure to customer and supplier bankruptcies.

risks.title: Climate Change and Carbon Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes potentially major impact of new GHG emission regulations with increased costs for Dana (taxes, facility improvements, energy). Global scientific consensus and stakeholder pressure reinforce severity. Risk is characterized as uncertain but critical.

risks.title: Dependence on Few Major Customers
risks.score_rationale: 76% of 2025 sales from top 10 customers. Loss of a single major customer or key program described as having material adverse impact. Risk is central and repeatedly emphasized.

risks.title: Trade Policy and Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed with concrete examples (tariffs on steel, aluminum, 2026 Supreme Court decision). Uncertainty about future measures emphasized. Direct impact on costs and global supply chain.

risks.title: Rising Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: Text mentions substantial adverse effect from rate increases, affecting vehicle demand and financing costs. While less central than other risks, clear direct macroeconomic impact on growth and acquisitions.

risks.title: Pandemics and Health Crises
risks.score_rationale: Risk illustrated by COVID-19 pandemic with prolonged supply chain impact. Strong language regarding material adverse effect. Text emphasizes interdependence of global chains beyond direct control.

risks.title: Unionized Workforce and Strikes
risks.score_rationale: Risk of strikes at Dana, suppliers or customers presented as potentially causing major operational disruptions. Linked to unionized actors, increasing likelihood of collective action.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Exposure
risks.score_rationale: 43% of sales outside the U.S., providing significant exposure. Text notes impact on margins and USD-denominated results. Hedging measures in place partially limit risk.

ai_positioning.summary: Dana Incorporated does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 2025 10-K filing. The digital solutions referenced (active and passive system controls, descriptive and predictive analytics) are not positioned as AI capabilities. No significant AI initiatives are documented.
